entries.subject: Bland / USGS 2023 processed Voyager CLEAR frames
entries.finding: The CLEAR frames in fully_processed.zip supply Monochrome from calibrated float I/F at about 335–1633 m/pixel. Native grids and ISIS metadata control registration. Per-frame Lunar-Lambert correction and overlap exposure normalization reduce acquisition shading but do not recover calibrated albedo or invert terrain shadows.

entries.subject: Schenk / LPI 2014 Voyager color mosaic
entries.finding: The 14,138 × 7,069 tnmap-cyl-KH.jpg supplies Enhanced color at roughly 600 m/pixel, with variable native color resolution. Orange/green/blue filters approximate natural color with enhanced contrast. The original ±180° map is rolled to east-positive coordinates; black unilluminated northern coverage stays missing.

entries.subject: USGS GlobalFill derivative
entries.finding: GlobalFill interpolates over map grid lines. The selected original observations retain missing coverage instead of adopting those interpolated pixels.
entries.revisitWhen: A controlled derivative distinguishes measured pixels from filled regions and supplies useful observed coverage beyond the selected originals.

entries.subject: USGS release prose versus embedded orthographic longitude
entries.finding: The embedded TIFF grid and original ISIS label specify a 15° east, 18° north orthographic center, while release prose says 15° west. Preparation follows the pixel-owned grid and label, rejects the opposite hemisphere, and preserves ISIS special values as missing.
